column1: # features.tsv — every omp feature that can send work to a local model, tied to its omp call site.
# Consumer: localbench/features.py (`localbench features [--json]`, doctor). One row per feature; tab-separated;
# `#` lines and blank lines are ignored; every field is non-empty (`-` for none). Call sites verified against
# @oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent 18.4.5 and pi-mnemopi in ~/.bun/install/global/node_modules/@oh-my-pi on 2026-09-30.
# consumer     product whose behavior the route changes (omp)
# feature      unique id; proof receipts name it in their `feature` field
# omp_package  package dir under node_modules/@oh-my-pi (pi-coding-agent, pi-mnemopi, pi-ai)
# omp_module   file relative to that package root; its sha256 is what a receipt's `omp_module_sha` must match
# omp_symbol   function/class/entry at the call site
# role         omp model-role chain the call site resolves, first set role wins (`judge>tiny>smol`);
#              `fastembed` = mnemopi's embedding model (local/<fastembed cache dir>)
# route_kind   model_role: always live, route_key = first role of the chain
#              agent:      bundled subagent, route_key = agent name; DISABLED when task.disabledAgents lists it
#              setting:    live while one `|`-separated alternative holds: all its `&`-joined conditions, each
#                          `key=value` / `key!=value` in omp's resolved settings (`omp config list --json`) or
#                          `native-judge` (the role chain resolves first to a System One API model, omp's
#                          hasNativeJudge; a models.yml provider with api typesafe counts)
# local        a target is local when its provider is built-in local (park.LOCAL_PROVIDERS) or the profile's
#              models.yml gives the provider a loopback baseUrl (e.g. ollama-sys1 -> 127.0.0.1:11434); a local
#              route straight to ollama's :11434 instead of the localbench gateway :11300 is a doctor WARN
# proof        a BETTER decision/memory run receipt for this feature, this module sha and the routed model's
#              digest (localbench/features.py PROOF CONTRACT); a setting row turned off at a gating value by its
#              preset (mnemopi-extraction at mnemopi.llmMode=none) is a no-model route, proved by pins.route
#              {kind fixed, id none} and pins.model_calls 0 instead of a digest
# proof_suite  localbench suite whose receipt proves the local route (decision, mem; - = none yet)
# preset       preset family that switches the route (kit-presets-switcher-r3l; - = none)
